lessons.claim: A check set 'equal' to a limit by construction fails by accident because of floating point. chain-bend defines T_obs ≡ 100·(2π/ω) and (100x)/x came out as 99.99999999999999, so 'the number of observed periods ≥ 100' raised a false warning. The same spec's dt/τ_fast ≤ 1e-2 happened to divide exactly and passed -- that coincidence must not be relied on. Fixed by putting a relative tolerance of 1e-12 into Check.ok (the same intent as bdbot.nondim.RATIO_RTOL).
